# Simple reverse check based on consecutive moves derived from res_path
# We'll reconstruct directions by differences.
import itertools

path = res_path  # using variable from prior block
ok = True
prev_vec = None
for i in range(1,len(path)):
    r0,c0 = path[i-1]
    r1,c1 = path[i]
    dr = r1 - r0
    dc = c1 - c0
    # each move should be exactly ±2 in one axis
    if not ((abs(dr)==2 and dc==0) or (abs(dc)==2 and dr==0)):
        ok = False
        break
    cur_dir = ('up' if dr==-2 else 'down') if dc==0 else ('left' if dc==-2 else 'right')
    if prev_vec:
        if (prev_vec=='up' and cur_dir=='down') or (prev_vec=='down' and cur_dir=='up') or (prev_vec=='left' and cur_dir=='right') or (prev_vec=='right' and cur_dir=='left'):
            ok = False
            break
    prev_vec = cur_dir
print('No-backward check:', ok)
